hero.lead: Dialogbot answers in English, around the clock, books appointments in your calendar and makes calls for you when you ask. You approve everything before it takes effect.

phone.alt: Example of a call Dialogbot takes for a carpenter: the customer calls, Dialogbot answers, finds a slot on Tuesday at 9 and books it.
lines: Hansen Carpentry, you're speaking with Dialogbot. How can I help?
Hi. I need a window replaced – can you come and take a look?
Yes. I have Tuesday at 9 or Wednesday at 1. Which suits you best?
That's booked. You'll get a text right away.

facts.title: In English
facts.text: With a voice you choose yourself

choose.lead: The same assistant, two worlds. Pick the one that looks like your everyday life.

business.title: Answers the phone when you can't.
business.text: Answers from the services and opening hours you have approved yourself. Books in your calendar and sends you a message about every call. You keep your number.

private.title: Makes the calls, so you don't have to.
private.text: Type or dictate a task. Peter makes lists, reminds you of what matters and calls the hairdresser, the garage or the doctor for you. Never before you have said yes.
private.uiLabel: Example of a conversation with Peter
private.ask: Shall I call Cykelkælderen and book Thursday at 3.30 pm?
private.done: Done – Thursday 3.30 pm. Added to your calendar.

how.lead: Three bricks and it runs. No menus to learn – the heavy lifting sits behind the assistant.

steps.title: The customer calls – as always
steps.text: On your own number. If you are busy or closed, Dialogbot picks up within two seconds and introduces itself as your receptionist.

steps.title: It answers and books
steps.text: From the services, prices and opening hours you have approved yourself. It never guesses. If the customer needs an appointment, it finds a free slot in the calendar and sends a text.

steps.title: You get a message
steps.text: Name, number and what it was about – as a text or e-mail right away, and a summary report every day.

can.lead: Six things, one assistant. Everything builds on knowledge you have approved yourself.

tiles.title: Answers the phone
tiles.text: Around the clock, in English. Says honestly that it is a digital assistant if the customer asks.

tiles.title: Books appointments
tiles.text: Finds free slots in Google Calendar or Microsoft 365, books, moves and cancels.

tiles.title: Answers on your website
tiles.text: The same knowledge as web chat. One line of code and it's on – in the evening too.

tiles.title: Sends texts and e-mails
tiles.text: Confirmation to the customer, a message to you. Short, no exclamation marks, from your name.

tiles.title: Calls customers back
tiles.text: Follows up on quotes or reminds about service – only customers who have said yes.

tiles.title: Peter – for you at home
tiles.text: Lists, reminders and calls to the dentist or the garage. You say yes first.

pricing.title: One subscription. No charge per enquiry.
pricing.lead: No lock-in. Do-it-yourself setup is included in the price.

private.name: Personal
points: Peter calls for you within your limits

items.q: Who answers when the customer calls?
items.a: Dialogbot – with your company name and a voice you have chosen yourself. If the customer asks, it says honestly that it is a digital assistant.

items.q: What if we answer the phone ourselves?
items.a: Then you do. Dialogbot only takes the calls you miss – or every call outside opening hours. You set the rule.

items.q: Can it book in our calendar?
items.a: Yes. Google Calendar and Microsoft 365 are included. It finds a free slot, books and sends the customer a text confirmation.
Nothing if you do it yourself – it takes about 30 minutes with Peter in the chat. If you want our specialists to connect your calendar, CRM or booking system, it costs {pSetup} once.
Yes, month to month. No lock-in, no fee. Personal can be cancelled any time in the app.

band.title: Ready to hear it?
band.text: Peter calls you back in under a minute – free and without signing up. If you would rather build it yourself, it takes 30 minutes.
